Name: Demetrius's Strawberry Dilemma
Author: AirynS
Description:
There's several other mods that edit Demetrius's 6 heart event, the infamous tomato argument, but all of them stick pretty close to the original argument. This is my take on it, a version which goes a little further away but still stays within character.

Demetrius comes home with a bag of strawberries that were on sale, eager to try out this idea he's recently heard about being able to substitute tomatoes with his favourite fruit. Robin, however, isn't as keen on the idea when she'd already had plans.


[size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]

[size=3]To install, simply extract and drop the "[CP] Demetrius's Strawberry Dilemma" folder into your Mods folder.[/size]


[size=3]Outfit mod in the screenshot is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]. The name of the mod is a nod to Fuzzlepuzzle's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7250]Demetrius's Tomato Dilemma[/url], which I recommend if Strawberry Dilemma isn't to your taste.[/size]
